title.en: What the B500S-83D Short-Boom Line Says lists, with Screed as the illustration
title.zh: B500S-83D的短臂架一行写了什么列出的内容，用「Screed」做插图

description.en: the B500S-83D Short-Boom Line Says. 5 m stays in the catalogue entry. Illustration: Screed.
description.zh: B500S-83D的短臂架一行写了什么。5 m仍在目录格子里。插图来自「Screed」。

h1.en: What the B500S-83D Short-Boom Line Says lists, with Screed as the illustration
h1.zh: B500S-83D的短臂架一行写了什么列出的内容，用「Screed」做插图

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists a boom line on one concrete pump in Xingtai: B500S-83D. The entry says short boom on the compact unit, not a truck-mounted placing boom. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Screed.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台只在一台混凝土泵上标出了臂架行：B500S-83D。电动、柴油和搅拌泵分类里的其他泵页没有用这句话来声称车载臂架。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Screed。

body.en: The figure is the one published at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Screed: Screed. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists a boom line on one concrete pump in Xingtai: B500S-83D. Quote it as written: short boom on the compact unit, not a truck-mounted placing boom. Diesel 120's 150 m / 500 m pair is the same kind of pipeline entry. They do not describe a truck-mounted placing boom, which is not a catalogue product.
body.zh: 这张图是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Screed页上的Screed。河北品锦机械在邢台只在一台混凝土泵上标出了臂架行：B500S-83D。电动80的 900 m / 300 m 是管道距离，不是臂长。

body.en: The entry says short boom on the compact unit, not a truck-mounted placing boom. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not add a boom length in metres beside that sentence. Do not rename those entries as boom reach.
body.zh: 电动、柴油和搅拌泵分类里的其他泵页没有用这句话来声称车载臂架。柴油120的 150 m / 500 m 也是同一类管道格。

body.en: No other pump page in the electric, diesel or mixer hubs uses that wording to claim a truck boom. The numeric reach remains 5 m and 5 m. The same page lists 7.5 kW, 380 V, materials 5–16 mm and net weight 280 kg.
body.zh: 短臂架不改变写出的距离，垂直和水平都是 5 m。同一页还标出 7.5 kW、380 V、材料 5–16 mm 和净重 280 kg。

body.en: The short boom does not change the shown reach, which is 5 m vertical and 5 m horizontal. Electric 80's 900 m / 300 m pair is a pipeline distance, not a boom length. Those entries describe B500S-83D.
body.zh: 河北品锦机械没有在这句话旁边再加一个以米计的臂长。

question.en: On this row: Does Pinjin list a truck boom?
question.zh: 品锦列出车载臂架了吗？

answer.en: No. The B500S-83D line says its short boom is not a truck-mounted placing boom. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Screed.
answer.zh: 没有。B500S-83D 写明短臂架不是车载布料杆。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Screed画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: How long is the short boom?

answer.en: The page does not list a separate boom length. It lists 5 m vertical and 5 m horizontal delivery. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Screed.
answer.zh: 页面没有另标出臂长。它标出的是垂直 5 m 和水平 5 m 输送距离。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Screed画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Is Electric 80 a boom because the distance is long?
question.zh: 电动80距离长，所以是臂架吗？

answer.en: No. Its 900 m / 300 m entry is a pumping-distance pair. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Screed.
answer.zh: 不是。它的 900 m / 300 m 是泵送距离数对。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Screed画面里印出的数字。

question.zh: 这行字是哪家工厂标出的？

answer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery, on the B500S-83D page, Xingtai. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Screed.
answer.zh: 河北品锦机械，在邢台的 B500S-83D 页面上。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Screed画面里印出的数字。
